workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain candidate census tract polygons covering State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a GeoPackage census tract dataset with spatial coverage sufficient to identify every census tract intersecting State College borough. Runtime QC must verify the candidate's spatial coverage, CRS, geometry validity, and supported format.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Identify the census tract polygons that intersect the supplied State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial intersection-based join or selection between the census tract polygons and the State College borough boundary. Preserve the tract features and their identifying attributes in the output. Do not infer or rename schema fields.

workflow_steps.title: Compute mean elevation by intersecting tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate mean DEM elevation for every census tract intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal mean elevation for each feature in the intersecting tract layer using the supplied GeoTIFF DEM raster inputs. Preserve a tract identifier and the computed mean value in the CSV output. Ground the actual identifier and output field names from runtime schema evidence; do not guess field names.

requirements.scope: Retrieved census tract candidate must cover the full State College borough boundary and its intersecting census tracts.
Retrieved census tract polygons must have a present, explicit CRS before spatial intersection.
Retrieved census tract polygons must be available as a GeoPackage for the spatial join.
Retrieved census tract polygons must have valid, non-empty geometries.
Census tract polygons and the State College borough boundary must use compatible CRSs for the binary spatial intersection.
Census tract and borough geometries must be valid for spatial intersection.
The supplied DEM rasters must have compatible grid definitions for the zonal calculation.
The DEM rasters and intersecting tract polygons must use compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
Intersecting tract polygons must have valid, non-empty geometries for zonal statistics.
The supplied DEM raster inputs must provide elevation coverage for every intersecting census tract zone.
The zonal statistics output must contain a tract identifier and the computed mean elevation value.

agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector geoprocessing including buffering, clipping, overlay/intersection, explicit geometry repair, and spatial joins. Binary spatial operations require compatible coordinate reference systems. Distance operations use the coordinate system and units of the provided input artifact.

skills.name: Vector Geoprocessing
skills.description: Performs spatial buffering, clipping, polygon intersection overlay, geometry validation/repair, and spatial joins.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for binary operations. Distance operations require projected coordinate reference systems.
other: The service performs only the requested operation.
It does not automatically reproject inputs or repair geometries unless explicitly requested.

input_datasets.description: One or two vector datasets in GeoPackage (.gpkg) or GeoJSON format.

operation.description: Explicit operation name (buffer, clip, overlay, geometry_repair, spatial_join).

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.

input_datasets.description: GeoTIFF raster file(s) and optional GeoPackage polygon zone layer.

operation.description: Explicit operation (zonal_statistics, raster_calculator, resample, clip, reproject_raster).

resolution.description: Target pixel resolution in meters for resampling.

target_crs.description: Target coordinate reference system for raster reprojection.
